english.note: Use 一份 for a distinct portion or an allocated share, especially when each person receives one.
Use 一份 for a defined portion or serving of something.
Use this when the portion is separately allocated, served, presented, or treated as one share.

examples.english: Everyone gets a proportion of the bonus.
